ruling.recommended_action: Refund S$2.54 to the rider as a Ryde voucher for the unexempted detour distance on this RydeTAXI trip; record the driver's RD-1 breach; send the driver account for review (repeat route-deviation offender) + flag_account

segment_findings.reason: Off-route segment after ~12:12 (driver crossed to the northbound side and ran a further AYE westbound loop, rejoining the corridor near 12:18 that the optimal route did not require). No passenger routing request (chat is only pickup logistics, RD-3/RD-5 not triggered) and no traffic corroboration on the replaced optimal-route section (traffic.incidents empty; the on-route bands are band 4 and band 5, not band 1/2; RD-4(b) is corroborative only), so under RD-1/RD-4(c) the segment's extra_km is unexempted and refundable under RD-2.

rejected_claims.reason: Driver's 'I followed my GPS; it rerouted me' is an RD-4 reasonable-cause claim unsupported by any traffic incident or band 1/2 record on the replaced section of the optimal route; system GPS/traffic records override the statement, so the detour is not exempted.
